target: doctor.sh — FORGE in the environment wins over a different FORGE in ./.env under doctor, because check sees the pre-load environment
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE=github
printf 'FORGE=none\n' > .env
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has sees_env 'github'
echo "leak_dotenv_value=$(printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -F 'none' | grep -Eic 'kind|forge')"
fx_done
